assets.name: reel
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent cutout for a Japanese fishing equipment selection website. Create a highly realistic premium product illustration of ONE mechanically accurate compact spinning fishing reel, seen in a three-quarter product view. The spool points diagonally toward the upper left; the slim mounting stem and horizontal reel foot extend to the upper right; one metal crank extends to the right with a rounded black EVA knob. Clearly show the circular machined aluminum spool, fine pale olive fishing line wound tightly on it, champagne-gold spool lip, dark drag adjustment cap, a continuous polished thin steel bail wire curving around the spool, rotor arms and line roller, a smoothly curved graphite and gunmetal body, precise bearing covers, small screws and subtle brushed metal highlights. Real manufactured geometry, rounded and sculpted body, realistic proportions and connections. Very detailed photorealistic catalog rendering, soft large studio lights, crisp focus, controlled reflections, physically plausible materials. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background with clear empty alpha around the entire object. Entire reel fits inside the canvas with generous 10 percent clear margins, square composition, object fills 80 percent of the image. No fishing rod, no hands, no labels, no letters, no brand, no logo, no watermark, no ground plane, no background, no cast shadow, no flat vector illustration, no low-poly facets, no toy appearance.
